messages:
hao: quick sync: ran a short bring-up for rwd-v2p3-int4 on the docs-long slice. baseline quality stable but we see a subtle rerank precision dip (rr@5) ~0.9% with p95 latency +35ms. thinking about how strict auto-fallback math should be.
marta: what sample size? and is this paired or unpaired?
hao: paired quiet-shadow, ~6.2k paired requests. bootstrap CI excludes zero: delta rr@5 = [-1.5%, -0.3%]. latency gains are small but consistent.
aj: 0.9% global rerank drop could be meaningful for search UX. my vote: require no high-importance slice to exceed -0.5% rr@5. otherwise block auto-promote. For global gating maybe allow up to -0.8% if within CI and sample >= 20k.
ciara: add protection against noisy signals: require breach to persist for 4 consecutive 5m windows before auto-fallback. also prefer paired p-value < 0.05 to trigger fallback.
hao: suggested automated gating: (1) paired p-value < 0.05 AND rr@5_delta <= -0.8% => immediate auto-fallback; (2) rr@5_delta between -0.8% and -0.3% => soft-fail: hold at 1% canary and require manual review if persists 3 windows; (3) latency p95 delta must be <= +50ms else abort.
marta: include a warmup pass for KV: require kv_hit_rate >= 60% after 1200 warmup requests on docs-long slice or treat rr drop as suspect.
aj: also track rerank MAE and top1 accuracy in parallel. propose composite metric: weighted_score = 0.7*rr@5_delta_normalized + 0.3*latency_penalty. require weighted_score >= -0.6 to pass auto-promote. Document weighting in release notes.
ciara: ops: add host-level guard: p99_gpu_latency_delta <= +80ms and oom_count == 0. if oom observed, immediate rollback.
hao: good. i'll encode the rules into a rollout policy and run a 12h quiet-shadow to collect more data before any auto-promotes.
rollout-bot: policy saved: {"variant":"rwd-v2p3-int4","pairing":"true","quiet_shadow_pct":"15","quiet_shadow_window":"12h","warmup_requests":"1200","kv_hit_rate":">=60%","auto_fallback_rules":"paired_p<0.05_and_rr5<=-0.8%_=>immediate,fuzzy_hold_between_-0.8_and_-0.3=>1%_canary_and_manual","latency_gate":"p95<=+50ms","host_guard":"p99_gpu<=+80ms,oom==0","stability_windows":"4x5m","weighted_score":"0.7*rr5+0.3*latency"} (use /rollout edit to update)
marta: thanks. please post the 12h snapshot and we can reconvene with the paired p-values and weighted score distribution. :white_check_mark:
